source: User's in-game test of the XP tile and Veteran's Exp Share

confirmed.scope: Kills made by the hero occupying the XP tile
confirmed.recipientRule: Veteran shares the killer's tile-boosted award with all heroes. A recipient's own tile gives no additional bonus to a shared kill.

model.xpTileAward: Killer's payout multiplied once by 1.20 while standing on the active XP tile
model.sharedAward: Killer's payout including its tile multiplier, times the effective Veteran share chance
model.referenceHandling: XP tile is separate from calibrated Rank EXP and Super/Ultra chances
model.search: Compare the XP tile on eligible killers against milestone, synergy and skill placements
model.comparison: Compare Normal, XP, Milestone, Synergy and Skill power for the current attacker. Score the leveling hero's direct or shared reward and allow legal tile exchanges.
model.mapDisabled: Assignments are retained but the tile has no effect
